# NeuroEdge gate walker as an ESP-IDF component (TSK-S4-02). Portable C99:
# the same sources build on the host (see Makefile) and on the ESP32-S3.
# The trees themselves are generated by `neuroedge build` as
# build/gates/<gate>.netree.h and linked as const (flash) by the application.
idf_component_register(SRCS "src/ne_walker.c"
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include")
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -Wconversion -Werror)
